column1: # Every name the catalogue is known to contain, so a runtime report can be
# reconciled against it by identity rather than by a plausible total.
# Exact capitalisation, never folded: MWL_MaypoleHut1 and MWL_MayPoleHut1 are
# two lookups and one of them is a registration failure.
# 'declared' is what the INPUT recorded; the runtime decides for itself whether
# a definition exists, and a disagreement is a finding, not a correction.
